text:
Alyssa: Quick ops check  launch posts + benchmark + webinar routing. Need: sitemap rows, JSON-LD for article + event, redirects for legacy slugs (8), UTM naming, hidden HubSpot fields, OG + canonical rules. Who picks what?
Priya: I can own JSON-LD + internal link plan. Will prepare Article markup for benchmark and Event for webinar. Also will list anchor text variants.
Jon: Ill do redirects + canonical handling. Quick Netlify example:
```
/old-campaign-2022  /launch/2026  301!
/blog/old-benchmark   /benchmark/2026  301
```
Will open PR once list confirmed.
Priya: JSON-LD sketch for webinar (fill time/speakers):
<script type="application/ld+json">{"@context":"https://schema.org","@type":"Event","name":"Launch Webinar","startDate":"2026-05-18T16:00:00Z","location":{"@type":"VirtualLocation","url":"https://redwood.example.com/webinar"}}</script>
Also Article: include mainEntityOfPage, headline, author, datePublished.
SEO Bot: Reminder: only index canonical paginated pages (page=1). Add rel=prev/next. Noindex tag archives that duplicate content. Strip utm_* from canonical.
Alyssa: Owners: Priya = JSON-LD + link map by EOD tomorrow; Jon = redirects + canonical PR; I'll validate HubSpot hidden fields (utm_campaign=launch_may2026) with CS. Reply with :white_check_mark: to ack.
Jon: \u2705 opening redirect PR after canonical list.
Priya: \u2705 working on JSON-LD and anchor list.
Alyssa: Great  thanks everyone. I'll schedule a 10m prelaunch QA the day before. :rocket:
